build: Strict C11 -O2,16 host suites, C++ public headers,80 ABI records/1418 assertions plus retained draw-indirect signature assignment. make -C runtime/c/backends/vulkan OUT=/tmp/doe-c-vulkan all check
first_failures: No backend build/host/source-validation or resource software execution failure reported for this increment. Source fixture consolidation and final identities are recorded by the resource receipt.
implementation: One shared native vertex-fetch capacity rule for direct and indirect. Whole-pass bindings precede exact16-byte GPU copies and source-generated guards. Every indirect draw uses distinct32-byte scratch retained by existing commands. Only native vkCmdDrawIndirect(count1,stride16) executes inside the pass; no producer hoist or in-pass compute/barriers.
limits: Indirect-first-instance is not enabled; nonzero firstInstance suppresses the entire draw, never only resets that field.
Indexed graphics and presentation remain unsupported. Guard has no CPU argument surrogate or shader interpreter.
Native host packet/geometry controls are not shader execution proof. Physical execution and performance parity unrun.
sanitizers: Focused draw_indirect_contract,render_contract,pass_contract with all backend sources -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined; detect_leaks=0. Resource composition additionally instruments resource/backend/labels/frozen shader owner, not external ICD or held compiler DSO.
scope: Developer guarded nonindexed graphics checks, explicit software ICD only; not independent acceptance or physical qualification.

software_composition.oracle: GPU-produced eight-draw pass, per-draw occlusion hit/zero/zero/zero/zero/hit/hit/zero, exact64 pixels, unchanged args/padding and12 finalizers. Different valid3/6-vertex records, UINT32_MAX first, instance2 invalidstride8/validstride0, nonzero firstInstance, zero and167-byte-invalid/168-byte-valid subrange. Native slot0 is a true unused hole.
